verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice's own API docs offer a downloadable Postman API collection. That collection is a machine-readable description of the REST API, a rough equivalent of an OpenAPI spec. A probe of standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404 everywhere, so no OpenAPI document was found. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec file, evidence of the Postman collection's completeness and schema detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: You can download our API collection and give it a swing.
The Zoho Invoice API allows you to perform all the operations that you do with our web client.
